item.title: Bristol, East Greenwich and Newport issue parking bans for snow removal
item.description: Rhode Island communities are still working to cleanup the roads after last weekend's snowstorm.

item.title: 50th Annual Meeting Street Telethon airs Jan. 31 on WPRI 12
item.description: WPRI 12, FOX Providence and The CW Providence are once again teaming up with Meeting Street and Cardi's Furniture for the 50th Annual Meeting Street Telethon.

item.title: Emergency shelters open overnight during freezing cold temps
item.description: The Pinpoint Weather 12 team says bitter cold temperatures are here to stay, with wind chills dipping as low as -20 degrees Fahrenheit late Thursday night and Friday morning. They warn that any exposed skin could be prone to frostbite in as little as 30 minutes.

item.title: Brown University taps firm to conduct security reviews following Dec. 13 shooting
item.description: The Ivy League school selected Teneo to conduct the review. The firm will use legendary police figure Bill Bratton in their assessment.

item.title: Video shows alleged assault by former Patriots player at RI gym
item.description: Patrick Pass is accused of pushing the man during an argument at the Planet Fitness off Mineral Spring Avenue on Aug. 28, 2024.

item.title: Exotic lizard found in Providence after snowstorm
item.description: A Providence man looking out the window after Sunday night's snowstorm spotted an unexpected visitor just outside his home: an exotic lizard.

item.title: RI may back $18M guarantee for Roger Williams, Fatima sale; rival bids sought
item.description: Rhode Island leaders on Thursday took a series of new steps aimed at ensuring the sale of Roger Williams Medical Center and Fatima Hospital, opening the door to a potential $18 million taxpayer backstop for a deal.

item.title: Man in custody after reported assault at Johnston home
item.description: Police arrested a Johnston man accused of assaulting a woman and then barricading himself in a home Thursday afternoon.

item.title: Providence has already removed 'nearly 300 truckloads' of snow
item.description: It's been four days since the last flakes fell, yet Providence remains partially paralyzed by the winter storm that dumped more than a foot of snow on much of Rhode Island.
